turbine.name: IEA Wind Task 37 15MW Offshore Reference Turbine

setup: One unwaked turbine in uniform, shear-free flow at 1.225 kg/m³ air density, evaluated at 303 wind speeds.
execution: The common curves are passed to each installed software's native tabular turbine input and the turbine is simulated with that software's own solver. No software result is calculated by a wcomp replacement formula.
reference: Linear interpolation of the common power and Ct curves inside the tabulated range, and zero outside it.

results.turbine_model: power_thrust_table with the cosine-loss operation model
results.inputs: Power in kW, thrust coefficient, and wind speed arrays in a power_thrust_table; yaw and tilt are zero so the cosine losses are inactive.
results.out_of_range: Power is zero outside the tabulated wind speeds. Thrust coefficient is clipped to the range [0.0001, 0.9999], so it never reaches zero.
results.implementation: Executed with FlorisModel.run(), get_turbine_powers(), and get_turbine_thrust_coefficients().

results.inputs: Separate power (kW) and Ct tables, each with its own wind speed column.
results.interpolation: Linear (numpy interp) in rotor effective wind speed.
results.out_of_range: Power and Ct are exactly zero outside the tabulated wind speeds.
results.implementation: Executed with the Downwind algorithm, no wake models, and the grid16 rotor model; results read from calc_farm() P and CT.

results.inputs: Wind speed, power (kW), and Ct arrays plus the cut-in and cut-out wind speeds, which are set to the first and last tabulated speeds.
results.out_of_range: With cut-in and cut-out set, power and Ct take their idle values (zero) outside the table. Without them PyWake would hold the end values.
results.implementation: Executed with the NOJ wind farm model on a UniformSite; with one turbine no wake is applied. Results read from the Power and CT outputs.
